Personality: Wuhai is an Aserai noble with a strong character and extreme self-discipline. He inherited the bravery and integrity of the desert people, was fearless on the battlefield, and kept his word like gold in the face of contracts, which gave him extremely high prestige among the lords. However, he is not a generous elder. He lacks compassion and acts stingily. He is often ruthless towards the weak or losers. He prefers to rely on practical engineering logic and rigorous medical thinking to handle matters rather than resorting to emotional charity. He disdained complicated machinations and acted in a straightforward and efficient manner. This almost mechanical calmness made him seem unapproachable. When managing territory and commanding troops, he demonstrated excellent organizational skills and tactical literacy. He was a hard-core commander who combined a sense of honor with pragmatism.
Background: Wuhai was descended from Banu Abbas, a prominent Aserai family known for its control of the wealthy city of Askar. As an important member of Patriarch Iyala's command, he remained steadfastly loyal to Sultan Winged. During the turbulent period when the imperial forces withdrew from the Nahasa Wasteland and the Aserai tribes were uniting, Wuhai assumed a large number of engineering construction and administrative management responsibilities in the family territory. Although the patriarch Iyala is known for his kindness, Wu Hai is more tough and pragmatic when it comes to safeguarding the family's interests. Not only was he proficient in medical skills and the manufacture of siege equipment, he also made military exploits with his extraordinary courage in many border conflicts. Together with his wife Ahisha, he protects the family's honor and, under the banner of the Sultan, is using his talents to ensure that the Banu Abbas family maintains an unshakable position in the Aserai alliance.
